name: run-finished-wrong-run-id-fatal
description: a RUN_FINISHED naming a different runId than the RUN_STARTED it would close is fatal — a run's two boundary events carry one identity, and an outcome about another run is not this run's outcome
kill: stop recording the open run's runId at RUN_STARTED, or stop comparing RUN_FINISHED.runId against it, and the close is accepted with its result adopted as the open run's
